query_contract: Panels refer to metric, recording-rule, or SLO identifiers; a selected provider adapter must translate these references.

panels.name: availability
panels.purpose: Compare service request success with the availability objective.

panels.name: latency
panels.purpose: Find high-latency services and compare them with the latency objective.

panels.name: error budget
panels.purpose: Show the remaining objective budget; calculate from valid and bad request events.

panels.name: service errors
panels.purpose: Find services with increasing classified failures.

panels.name: route traffic
panels.purpose: Identify request-volume changes by bounded route and response class.

panels.name: gateway latency
panels.purpose: Compare route latency with the request objective.

panels.name: upstream failures
panels.purpose: Separate upstream dependency failures from gateway request errors.

panels.name: saturation
panels.purpose: Show gateway worker or connection-pool utilization against capacity.

panels.name: attempts
panels.purpose: Show aggregate authentication attempt volume by bounded result.

panels.name: authentication failures
panels.purpose: Detect failures by safe reason without exposing credentials or account identifiers.

panels.name: authentication latency
panels.purpose: Find slow authentication requests by service and route template.

panels.name: lockouts
panels.purpose: Monitor account-protection pressure using aggregate lockout events only.

panels.name: service health
panels.purpose: Show healthy, degraded, unavailable, and unknown service states.

panels.name: request latency
panels.purpose: Identify slow operations by service and route template.

panels.name: dependency failures
panels.purpose: Identify downstream error classes without exposing request payloads.

panels.name: worker saturation
panels.purpose: Show worker and connection capacity pressure before an outage.

panels.name: attempt outcomes
panels.purpose: Show aggregate payment outcomes without transaction identifiers or payloads.

panels.name: processing latency
panels.purpose: Find slow payment operations by provider and safe outcome.

panels.name: provider errors
panels.purpose: Show categorized provider failures without credentials or customer data.

panels.name: reconciliation lag
panels.purpose: Show the age of pending reconciliation work without transaction identifiers.

panels.name: delivery outcomes
panels.purpose: Compare delivered and failed aggregate outcomes by channel.

panels.name: delivery latency
panels.purpose: Find slow provider delivery without recipient or message content.

panels.name: queue depth
panels.purpose: Identify notification backlog without inspecting message content.

panels.name: oldest queued age
panels.purpose: Identify the age of the oldest queued notification.

panels.name: retries
panels.purpose: Show retry pressure by bounded channel and safe reason.

panels.name: connections
panels.purpose: Show active connections by transport and region, without account labels.

panels.name: event latency
panels.purpose: Show publish-to-delivery latency without recording event payloads.

panels.name: disconnects
panels.purpose: Identify unexpected connection losses by bounded reason.

panels.name: delivery failures
panels.purpose: Show delivery and subscription failures by safe reason.

panels.name: message throughput
panels.purpose: Show accepted communication events by channel without private content.

panels.name: delivery outcomes
panels.purpose: Compare aggregate provider delivery outcomes.

panels.name: provider failures
panels.purpose: Show categorized provider failures without destination identifiers.

panels.name: provider latency
panels.purpose: Show provider response latency by channel.

panels.name: update freshness
panels.purpose: Show age of the newest processed update without coordinates.

panels.name: processing failures
panels.purpose: Find failed location processing by safe error class.

panels.name: delivery latency
panels.purpose: Show event delivery latency without route or location payload.

panels.name: lookup latency
panels.purpose: Find slow bounded geospatial lookups without coordinates or query values.

panels.name: availability
panels.purpose: Show database health state from bounded read-only probes.

panels.name: query latency
panels.purpose: Show client operation latency by safe operation class, not SQL text.

panels.name: connection utilization
panels.purpose: Show pool and server connection usage without application data.

panels.name: replication and backup age
panels.purpose: Show replication delay and backup age as separate series using the same time unit.

panels.name: availability
panels.purpose: Show Redis health from read-only dependency probes.

panels.name: memory utilization
panels.purpose: Compare Redis memory use with configured capacity.

panels.name: command latency
panels.purpose: Show command latency by bounded command class, never key or value.

panels.name: evictions
panels.purpose: Track cache eviction count without reading keys or values.

panels.name: replication lag
panels.purpose: Track Redis replication delay by replica role.

panels.name: compute utilization
panels.purpose: Show CPU and memory headroom by host and region.

panels.name: disk throughput
panels.purpose: Show disk IO volume by device and direction.

panels.name: network errors
panels.purpose: Show packet error rate by host interface and direction.

panels.name: container restarts
panels.purpose: Identify restart increases by bounded workload identity.

panels.name: authentication failures
panels.purpose: Show aggregate authentication failures without credential or account identifiers.

panels.name: authorization denials
panels.purpose: Show denied actions by bounded safe reason.

panels.name: rate limits
panels.purpose: Show throttling pressure by bounded policy, not client identity.

panels.name: control failures
panels.purpose: Identify control failures and anomaly counts by safe control category.
